english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something in the same way or to the same extent, including “love them all the same.”
This is the all-purpose spoken choice when people or things act, feel, or are affected in the same way or to the same degree.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that someone does something in a similar way.
Use 一樣 for doing something in the same way as someone or something previously mentioned.

examples.english: I love my two sons the same.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 loeng5 go3 zai2 jat1 joeng6 gam3 sek3
soeng1 baau1 toi1 lin4 siu3 seng1 dou1 jat1 joeng6

examples.english: I did it similarly to you, and it worked quite well.
examples.traditional: 我跟你一樣咁做，效果幾好。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gan1 nei5 jat1 joeng6 gam3 zou6 haau6 gwo2 gei2 hou2

examples.english: I do it likewise, the way he does.
examples.traditional: 佢點樣做，我就一樣點樣做。
